node.statement: Target algebra and quantitative projections. Applying lem-compcb-corner-algebra to P_R gives A_R the compressed product, inherited involution and unit I_{A_R}=Co^A_{P_R}(P_R), making it an extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra for epsilon_{A_R}=C_ca*(t+epsilon_A)<=2*C_ca*t. Applying lem-maincb-nested-corner-comparison to (R,P,Q)=(P_R,P_U,P_j) gives that P_U^R and P_j^R are C_nest*t-projections in A_R.
